// Command expogen writes the exposition CloudNativePG's exporter would serve
// for the given custom queries, using CNPG v1.30.0's own metrics package.
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/Masterminds/semver/v3"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/stdlib"
	"github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus"
	"github.com/prometheus/common/expfmt"

	"expogen/metrics"
)

func main() {
	host := flag.String("host", "", "host")
	files := flag.String("queries", "", "comma-separated query files (defaults first)")
	def := flag.String("db", "postgres", "default database")
	primary := flag.Bool("primary", true, "instance is primary")
	flag.Parse()
	open := func(db string) (*sql.DB, error) {
		cfg, err := pgx.ParseConfig(fmt.Sprintf("host=%s port=5432 user=cnpg_metrics_exporter dbname=%s sslmode=disable", *host, db))
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		cfg.RuntimeParams["search_path"] = "pg_catalog, public, pg_temp"
		cfg.RuntimeParams["application_name"] = "cnpg_metrics_exporter"
		return sql.Open("pgx", stdlib.RegisterConnConfig(cfg))
	}
	conn, err := open(*def)
	must(err)
	var vnum string
	must(conn.QueryRow("SELECT current_setting('server_version_num')").Scan(&vnum))
	var dbs []string
	rows, err := conn.Query("SELECT datname FROM pg_catalog.pg_database WHERE datallowconn AND NOT datistemplate AND pg_catalog.has_database_privilege(datname, 'CONNECT') ORDER BY 1")
	must(err)
	for rows.Next() {
		var d string
		must(rows.Scan(&d))
		dbs = append(dbs, d)
	}
	var n int
	fmt.Sscan(vnum, &n)
	version := semver.MustParse(fmt.Sprintf("%d.%d.0", n/10000, n%100))
	q := metrics.NewQueriesCollector("cnpg", nil, *def)
	for _, f := range strings.Split(*files, ",") {
		b, err := os.ReadFile(f)
		must(err)
		must(q.ParseQueries(b))
	}
	q.Generate(open, dbs, *primary, version, time.Now())
	reg := prometheus.NewRegistry()
	reg.MustRegister(unchecked{q})
	mfs, err := reg.Gather()
	must(err)
	enc := expfmt.NewEncoder(os.Stdout, expfmt.NewFormat(expfmt.TypeTextPlain))
	for _, mf := range mfs {
		must(enc.Encode(mf))
	}
}

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

// unchecked registers the collector without descriptor checks.
type unchecked struct{ c prometheus.Collector }

func (unchecked) Describe(chan<- *prometheus.Desc)    {}
func (u unchecked) Collect(ch chan<- prometheus.Metric) { u.c.Collect(ch) }
